ID: `better-interface`.

## What it does

Defines a specific screen or flow and applies accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI detail checks, in that order. Combines issues into one list ordered by user impact, consolidating defects with the same cause. Includes empty, loading and error states and relevant widths. The review is read-only until you ask to apply its findings.

## When to use it

Use it when you explicitly request a comprehensive assessment of an experience. If the problem is already bounded, use the skill for that domain. Reviews of branches, PRs or uncommitted changes instead follow the interface-review procedure, if available.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/better-interface` in Claude Code or `$better-interface` in Codex. Name the flow, goal, states and review scope. Request one table with evidence, priorities and corrections; the report must distinguish what was observed from what was not checked.

## What it delivers

- Scope and coverage of the six areas
- Consolidated issue list, up to 15 findings
- Checks performed and review outcome

## Example

Review the entire project creation flow, from entry to success, including errors, the empty state and mobile. Deliver findings only for now.

## Prerequisites

- Requires the six better-* skills in the catalog; a missing area is declared unreviewed.
